entries.text: aries don't have red flags. they have a whole opening ceremony
taurus will cancel plans just to lay in bed and think about the plans
gemini has 4 personalities and somehow you're texting the wrong one rn
cancer said "im over it" then wrote a 3 page essay in their notes app
leo apologizes like "im sorry you made me do that"
virgo said "im not judging" with the eyes of someone filing a full report
libra can't even pick a favorite color and you want them to pick a person??
scorpio knows your birth time, your ex's birth time, and your wifi password. you met tuesday
sagittarius will ghost you from inside the same room
capricorn flirts by sending you a calendar invite
aquarius heard "be normal" one time and took it as a threat
pisces already had the whole relationship with you in their head. you lost. you weren't even there
